name: Exact Marked Maximum-Parent Recognition
statement: Let $C$ be a nonempty proper class on visible coordinates $X$, fix an auxiliary mark $\tau$ on $A$, and choose one pattern $f_T$ on every $(r+1)$-support of $X\sqcup A$. Call $f_T$ active when its auxiliary restriction agrees with $\tau$. The avoider $M_f$ is a rank-$r$ maximum parent with section $M_f[\tau]=C$ exactly when: every local agreement graph is connected; every active pattern's visible restriction contains a minimally missing pattern of $C$; and every minimally missing pattern of $C$ occurs as the visible restriction of an active selected pattern.
proof: Local connectivity is exactly maximumity. In a maximum class the selected patterns are all minimally missing. If the marked section is $C$, every active restriction is missing from $C$, hence contains a minimal missing pattern; minimizing a missing extension of each pattern of $C$ gives an active selected pattern with exactly that visible restriction. Conversely, the containment condition keeps every word of $C$ in the marked section, while coverage of every minimal missing pattern excludes every visible word outside $C$.
